guards: Require test_data explicitly false, is_disputed false, country US, province AL, date 2026-11-03, exact name/office/scope and actual JSON null district.
Validate all 67 distinct AL county FIPS, configured region IDs/names and County type.
Verify candidate IDs, names, publisher parties and configured ballot identities. Preserve source_party; Nonpartisan Yes/No are ballot choices YES/NO.
Reconcile candidate county sums to top-level totals before acceptance; unavailable write-ins remain unknown, not zero.
Select a single source per race/county, preferring healthy official precinct totals; county fallback must never be added atop same county precinct totals.
Setup zeros and zero reporting are not evidence of counties reporting. Retain raw snapshots/hashes and source freshness; no live positive result latency has been established.
